scope.hassanZoneNote: ICAR-CRIDA Hassan plan (p1) places Hassan mainly in the Southern Transition Zone (KA-7), with taluk blocks in Zone-4 (Central Dry), Zone-6 (Southern Dry) and Zone-9 (Hilly). The brief calls Hassan 'southern dry zone'; only the Zone-6 portion is southern dry. Neighbouring Southern Dry Zone district plans (Mysore, Mandya, Chamarajanagar) are recorded as region IN-KA with sourceDistrict, never as IN-KA-hassan.
scope.coimbatoreZoneNote: ICAR-CRIDA Coimbatore plan (p1): Western Zone (TN-3) and High Altitude and Hilly Zone (TN-7). TNAU 'Western Zone' rows naming Coimbatore are recorded as IN-TN-coimbatore; statewide TNAU rows are IN-TN.
scope.regionNote: Pass 2 adds region IN-west-coast (with candidateFor IN-KA and reviewStatus pending_user_decision) for the ginger West Coast planting rows. It is not counted as a KA window.

methods.weekToDate: CRIDA 'Nth week' of a month converted as 1st=01-07, 2nd=08-14, 3rd=15-21, 4th=22-month end; '1st FN' (fortnight)=01-15; a month-only bound uses the 1st or last day of the month. Conversion is arithmetic, not a source value. Pass 2: '2nd fortnight' = 16-month end.
methods.seasonLabel: Source season label kept where the source gives one (CRIDA Kharif/Rabi/Summer rows). Otherwise assigned from the start month: Feb-Apr summer, May-Aug kharif, Sep-Jan rabi. TN pattam names are kept in notes.
methods.rotationRoleRule: Legumes with a cited BNF statement = nitrogen_fixer. Others derived from a cited per-hectare N uptake/removal at the source's stated yield or the cited recommended N dose: >=120 kg N/ha heavy_feeder, 60-119 moderate_feeder, <60 light_feeder. This threshold rule is a project analytic convention (rule v1), not a published classification; role is null when no cited N figure exists.
methods.stages: Day 0 = sowing or planting (FAO-56 notes the initial stage of transplanted crops starts at transplanting). FAO stage splits (Kc initial/development/mid/late) are used only where FAO publishes a row; the crop-specific source is used where one exists. FAO rows are not KA/TN cultivar phenology.
methods.dataCompleteness: Scored fields: family, productIds, rotationRole, nutrientUptake, waterNeedMm, rainfedSuitable, durationDays, stages, sowingWindows (any KA or TN), predecessors/successors (one field), avoidAfter, seasonalRisks; plus nitrogenCreditKgPerHa for legumes (13 fields) else 12. A field counts only if it carries a cited source. Family is counted from standard taxonomy with the botanical name taken from repo crop-profiles; not a retrieved document. Pass 2 (2026-11-01): all 28 crops recomputed with a strict rule: a list field counts only when non-empty, rainfedSuitable only when present, sowingWindows only for an IN-KA* or IN-TN* row. The first pass had over-counted one field for nine crops. Each record now lists its missing fields.
methods.nitrogenCredit: Pass 2: crop-specific value preferred over the FAO generic 40-50 kg/ha. Specificity labels: crop_specific_state_university (UAS/TNAU recommendation naming the successor), crop_specific_india_review (Indian review quoting Ghosh et al. 2007; successor not named), generic_preceding_legume (FAO). The generic value is kept in genericFallback.
methods.stateFallback: Pass 3: a sowing row with stateFallback false (the coastal Dakshina Kannada rows) must not be used as an IN-KA state-level fallback for Hassan or any other non-coastal district. Rows without the key keep the earlier behaviour (a state-level IN-KA row from another district carries sourceDistrict and is a neighbour reference, not a Hassan window).
methods.contingencyWindows: Pass 3: rows with evidenceType contingency_plan and reviewStatus provisional are ICAR-CRIDA 2011 delayed-onset recommendations. The from/to dates are the delay week printed in the plan (for example 'May 3rd week' = 05-15 to 05-21), not a sowing window printed by the source. A crop is encoded only where the table names it as a sole crop, intercrop or first crop of a sequence, so the delay week is its sowing week; second crops after paddy, potato, maize or ragi and 'late kharif' entries are not encoded.
